campaignsText: MadCat's campaign was characterized by a brief online presence, suggesting limited operational capacity. Their targeting of dark web users seeking fraudulent identity documents indicates they may have aimed to exploit criminal networks rather than traditional ransomware targets.
description: MadCat appears to be a short-lived疑似ransomware犯罪集团，于2023年底短暂出现。他们涉嫌在暗网以提供虚假被盗护照为诱饵进行欺诈活动。由于其网站迅速成为死链接，他们的真实运营情况存疑。
goals: MadCat's primary motivation is financial gain through fraud. They likely target individuals seeking to exploit other criminals by offering fake stolen passports, indicating a focus on deception and identity theft rather than widespread ransomware campaigns.
